newsitem.title: USA: Mobil Mary Ann field has record natgas flow.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Mary Ann field has record natgas flow.

text.p: Mobil Corp said On Tuesday that Mobil Exploration & Producing US Inc has begun production from a second reservoir in its Lower Mobile Bay - Mary Ann Field with a well that is flowing natural gas at one of the highest rates ever recorded in the Gulf of Mexico.

The company said that the Mary Ann 95-5 well, drilled to a measured depth of 24,256 feet, is now producing natural gas from the prolific Norphlet formation at a gross rate of 85 million cubic feet a day (MMCFD) and is expected to operate at an average rate of more than 65 MMCFD.
Mobil said it also has discovered two other commercial fields that will bring Mobil's net production offshore Alabama to more than 250 MMCFD when they are brought on stream next year.
